name: Vento Labs
description: Vento Labs designs and builds custom AI agents and automation systems for businesses — cutting operating costs, automating operations, and scaling without adding headcount. This Agent Card advertises Vento Labs' delivery skills so other AI agents can discover and route work to the team.

skills.name: Custom AI Agent Development
skills.description: Custom AI agents built on Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph, and CrewAI — self-hosted on your infrastructure. Agents integrate with Telegram, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, email, and your internal tools, and can use any LLM (including local models).
examples: Build a self-hosted AI agent that handles inbound LinkedIn messages and qualifies leads.
Deploy a multi-agent system that monitors Telegram channels and produces a daily signal summary.

skills.name: Operational AI Automation
skills.description: End-to-end automation of business operations — from lead capture to invoicing — replacing manual handoffs between chats, spreadsheets, and email threads.
examples: Automate lead intake from website forms into the CRM with AI-driven enrichment and qualification.
Replace manual order processing with an agent that reads supplier emails and updates inventory.

skills.name: AI Consulting & Team Training
skills.description: Consulting and hands-on team training to make AI adoption stick — process audits, workshops, and a prioritized roadmap for embedding AI in daily work.
examples: Audit a finance team's workflows and produce a prioritized AI automation roadmap.
Run a hands-on workshop teaching a sales team to use Claude for prospect research and outreach.

skills.name: AI Platform (Company-Wide AI Workspace)
skills.description: A company-wide AI operating system — dedicated agents per team (sales, support, marketing, operations), a Knowledge Vault indexing internal documentation, role-based access, and usage/ROI reporting. Connected to the client's tools and secured on their infrastructure; live in about 4 weeks.
examples: Deploy an AI workspace for 45 employees across 5 departments with department-scoped permissions.
Stand up an enterprise Claude/GPT gateway with audit logs and per-team usage caps.

skills.name: AI Data Center Development
skills.description: End-to-end development of AI data centers for investors and owners — configuration and TCO sizing, site search screened on deliverable grid capacity, securing land and power, transmission interconnection, modular construction, commissioning, and operation. Typical projects 10–100+ MW, phased; modular deployment in 3–6 months against 24–36 for conventional construction.
examples: Assess whether a 20 MW AI data center makes sense for a given budget and target geography.
Screen a candidate parcel against deliverable transmission capacity, water, fiber, and permitting before purchase.

skills.name: AI Content Factory for E-commerce
skills.description: Turns a product catalog into a daily stream of discovery content — product cards, social posts, comparison articles — automatically generated from SKU data.
examples: Generate daily TikTok scripts for 500 SKUs based on inventory and trending hooks.
Auto-publish product comparison articles when new SKUs are added to the catalog.

skills.name: Supplier Communication Agent
skills.description: Reads unstructured supplier messages across email, WhatsApp, and Telegram and updates the catalog with prices, stock levels, lead times, and new SKUs.
examples: Parse supplier WhatsApp price-list updates and sync the live catalog with an audit trail.
Auto-create draft purchase orders when suppliers announce a restock in chat.

skills.name: ERP Agent for 1C
skills.description: A safe AI layer over 1C and similar ERP systems — speak business language, get permissioned reads and writes, with guardrails that prevent the AI from breaking core data.
examples: Ask the ERP for last quarter's overdue invoices in plain language.
Approve a pre-validated stock adjustment via chat without opening the 1C UI.

skills.name: Bankruptcy AI for Arbitration Trustees
skills.description: An AI platform purpose-built for Russian-market arbitration trustees — automates case-file analysis, document drafting, and procedural steps under bankruptcy law.
examples: Analyze a debtor's case file and surface actionable findings for the trustee.
Draft procedural filings from case context with citation-aware templates.
